segments.name: Paperboard
segments.description: Manufactures and supplies SBS paperboard packaging products for independent converters, merchants and commercial printers in North America.
segments.evidence: Clearwater Paper is recognized as a leading manufacturer and supplier of Solid Bleached Sulfate (SBS) paperboard packaging products, serving independent converters throughout North America.

revenueModel.text: Packaging converters, merchants and commercial printers in North America pay for paperboard sold to them, including sheeting and distribution services.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of our paperboard is sold to packaging converters in North America through sales managers located throughout the United States, with a smaller percentage channeled through distribution to commercial printers.

changes.text: In 2024 the company divested its tissue business, previously reported as the Consumer Products segment.
changes.evidence: Subsequently, in October 2024, our tissue business, previously reported as the Consumer Products segment and focused on producing private label tissue items, was divested to Sofidel America Corp, a wholly owned subsidiary of Sofidel S.p.A..
